items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: as he was in charge of the brass band, I became affiliated with the brass band.

ctx.x: we had a conversation and I told him about my musical background. He was very surprised that, you know --. He said, 'Well, look, you're a kid, and I can take you to someone who could probably help you to continue your studies.'
So he took me to Mr. Glaudius Marshall, who was a choirmaster, organist and conductor of the St. Marks 138th Street -- What do you call it -- Brass Band.
The church had a brass band?
